# CI invariants (.github/)

Full pipeline reference and the health-check contract live in [`docs/development/ci-pipeline.md`](../docs/development/ci-pipeline.md) and [`docs/development/ci-caching.md`](../docs/development/ci-caching.md).

- **CI cache is load-bearing and fails silently** — six rules: `CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_LAUNCHER` is **per language** (a language without its own launcher silently never reaches ccache; on macOS that means `OBJC`/`OBJCXX` too, or all 103 JUCE Objective-C++ units rebuild cold; `scripts/ci-cache-check.sh` audits the generated ninja files for this); `ci.yml` keeps its `push: main` trigger (caches are ref-scoped — without a main-scoped cache no PR can restore one); `build/_deps` is keyed on `cmake/DependencyVersions.cmake` only, never `CMakeLists.txt` (pin new dependencies there); `CCACHE_DIR` is set explicitly per job (defaults differ by OS and ccache version); **PR runs restore only, never save** — only `push: main` (`github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'`) saves, and that save is followed by a prune step that deletes superseded main-scoped generations, so PR-scoped cache entries never accumulate and evict main's seed caches. → [`docs/development/ci-caching.md`](../docs/development/ci-caching.md)
- **The file-size guard is a required Lint-job check, not advisory** — `scripts/check-file-sizes.sh` against its ratchet baseline `scripts/file-size-baseline.txt`; root `CLAUDE.md` § Code structure has the split rules. → [`docs/development/file-size-guard.md`](../docs/development/file-size-guard.md)
- **PR titles must be conventional-commit subjects, checked by the `pr-title.yml` "PR Title" job — a required check as of FRO170** — `type(scope)!: subject` (types: `feat`/`fix`/`docs`/`ci`/`chore`/`refactor`/`test`/`perf`/`build`; scope is by convention the ticket id, e.g. `FRO112`; a breaking change gets `!` before the colon). Enforced this way because merges are squash-only and GitHub defaults the squash subject to the PR title, not any individual commit message. Landed non-required (FRO182); became required in the same branch-protection pass as FRO170's Docs check. → [`docs/development/pr-title-convention.md`](../docs/development/pr-title-convention.md)
- **`main`'s branch protection requires five status checks** — `Lint`, `Build, Test, and Coverage`, `Build and Test (macOS)` (ci.yml), `Docs` (docs.yml), and `PR Title` (pr-title.yml, FRO170) — never rename any of those five job `name:` strings, or the matching required check goes permanently pending. `Build and Test (Windows)` runs on push to main and `workflow_dispatch` only since 2026-09-26 and is not required: it was the slowest check on every PR (14 to 47 min) and, per FRO242, could not fail on a test failure. On a docs-only PR, ci.yml's own three PR jobs don't run (its `paths:` filter excludes `docs/**`/`*.md`) — `ci-passthrough.yml` posts a synthetic success under those three names instead, so the PR stays normally mergeable without `gh pr merge --admin`. → [`docs/development/docs-guard.md`](../docs/development/docs-guard.md)
